table.name: city
table.purpose: Catalog of world cities with their population, the country they belong to, and the administrative district (state/province/region) within that country. Each row is one city. This is the classic MySQL 'world' sample database city table.

CountryCode.name: CountryCode
CountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country the city belongs to (e.g. CHN, IND, USA, PHL). References country.Code (many cities per country).

District.name: District
District.description: Name of the first-level administrative subdivision (state, province, region) the city is located in, e.g. England, São Paulo, California, Central Luzon, Nagano. Values are free text and not normalized (some misspellings like 'West Bengali').

ID.name: ID
ID.description: Primary key: surrogate integer identifier for the city (1–4079, no gaps). Referenced by country.Capital, which stores the city ID of each country's capital. (The join to country.IndepYear is a spurious statistical coincidence.)

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Name of the city (e.g. Lubao, Binjai, Matsumoto). Not unique — 78 cities share a name with at least one other (e.g. Cambridge, Córdoba, Hamilton).

Population.name: Population
Population.description: Number of inhabitants of the city (persons). Ranges from 42 to 10,500,000; median ~167,000.

table.name: country
table.purpose: Reference table of world countries (MySQL world sample database). One row per country/territory with demographic, geographic and political data. Referenced by city and countrylanguage via Code.

Capital.name: capital_city_id
Capital.description: ID of the country's capital city; references city.ID (one-to-one). Null for territories without a capital in the city table.

Code.name: country_code
Code.description: Primary key: 3-letter ISO country code (e.g. ABW, GBR). Referenced by city.CountryCode and countrylanguage.CountryCode.

Code2.name: iso2_country_code
Code2.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (AD, AE, AF...).

Continent.name: continent
Continent.description: Continent the country belongs to; one of Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania, Antarctica.

GNP.name: gnp
GNP.description: Gross National Product, in millions of US dollars (max 8,510,700 for the US). 0 for territories without data.

GNPOld.name: gnp_old
GNPOld.description: Gross National Product from an earlier reference year, in millions of US dollars; null for ~25% of countries.

GovernmentForm.name: government_form
GovernmentForm.description: Form of government, e.g. Republic, Constitutional Monarchy, Federal Republic, Dependent Territory of the UK.

HeadOfState.name: head_of_state
HeadOfState.description: Name of the head of state (circa 1998-2000 data: George W. Bush, Jacques Chirac, Elisabeth II).

IndepYear.name: independence_year
IndepYear.description: Year the country became independent; null for dependent territories. Negative values (e.g. -1523) indicate BCE dates.

LocalName.name: local_name
LocalName.description: Country name in its local language(s) or official form (e.g. 'Lao', 'Al-Jaza'ir/Algérie').

Population.name: population
Population.description: Country population in persons (max ~1.28 billion, China); 0 for uninhabited territories.

Region.name: region
Region.description: Sub-continental region within the continent (e.g. Caribbean, Western Africa, Southeast Asia).

SurfaceArea.name: surface_area_sq_km
SurfaceArea.description: Land area in square kilometers (max 17,075,400 for Russia).

table.name: countrylanguage
table.purpose: Lists languages spoken in each country, with the share of the population speaking each language and whether it is an official language. One row per (country, language) pair. This is the classic MySQL 'world' sample database table countrylanguage, joining to country via CountryCode.

CountryCode.name: country_code
CountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country in which the language is spoken. References country.Code (many languages per country).

IsOfficial.name: is_official
IsOfficial.description: Whether the language is an official language of the country. 'T' = true (official), 'F' = false (not official).

Language.name: language
Language.description: Name of the language spoken in the country (e.g. English, Arabic, Urdu, Creole English).

Percentage.name: percentage
Percentage.description: Percentage (0-100) of the country's population that speaks the language. 0.0 appears for languages with negligible/unknown share.
